description: Desktop app that plays customizable keyboard and mouse sounds, with sound profiles, audio effects, and per-application rules.
notes: The upstream Windows release is an NSIS installer, not a dedicated portable ZIP. Scoop extracts its payload instead of executing the installer.

Because the installer is not run, its WebView2 runtime bootstrap, Start Menu/Desktop links, file associations, and uninstaller registration are not applied. Windows needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime; install it separately if it is missing.
Keyboard Sounds Pro stores its profiles, rules, and related data under %USERPROFILE%\keyboardsounds-pro, outside the Scoop app directory. This manifest does not relocate that data to D:.
The upstream project has an open request for a native portable build: https://github.com/keyboard-sounds/keyboardsounds-pro/issues/26.
